findings: RolesGuard fail-open on unannotated handlers — Any handler added without @Roles() will be accessible to any authenticated user, regardless of role. Add a lint rule or nest-access-control policy to make missing annotations fail at startup rather than fail at runtime.

firstName/lastName default to empty string on register — RegisterDto marks both optional with no @IsOptional() decorator; class-validator behavior is version-dependent. AuthService fills missing values with '', which the schema persists as a non-nullable String. Make the DTO and schema consistent on whether these fields are required.

No duplicate-email guard in register — AuthService.register has no try/catch for Prisma P2002 (unique constraint violation), so a duplicate email returns 500 instead of 409 Conflict. Add a catch for PrismaClientKnownRequestError with code P2002 and throw ConflictException.
